claim: Computer-using agents for healthcare operations. Founded in 2025 by Georges Casassovici and Mathieu Rihet, Novoflow has 6 employees based in San Francisco. Novoflow is hiring for 4 roles in engineering and sales.
Mathieu Rihet, Founder/CEO: Emory University Scholar. Previously a medical interpreter. Building AI employees to automate 99% of manual workflows in medical clinics.
Georges Casassovici, Founder/CTO: Always take small steps in the right direction. Building Novoflow to solve healthcare interoperability in the next 5 years.
Website description: Novoflow deploys computer-using AI agents that operate a medical practice's EHR to automate its biggest operational bottleneck in weeks.
